_doc: Allowlist for the vendored agent-skills subset (spec 0100). Edit groups/enabled_groups/excluded here, then re-run `quantsmith-agent-skills sync`. Never edit vendor/agent-skills/ by hand. See instructions/agent_skills.md.

excluded.skills/spec-driven-development/: Writes a root SPEC.md with its own ID scheme, bypassing specs/NNNN-slug/ and the spec-check gate (P1, P2).
excluded.skills/planning-and-task-breakdown/: Writes plan/task artifacts outside specs/NNNN-slug/ and without REQ-/T- traceability (P1, P2).
excluded.skills/using-agent-skills/: Meta-router that sends work to the excluded /spec, /plan, /build and /ship commands; QuantSmith routing is workflow_orchestrator plus instructions/agent_skills.md.
excluded.skills/idea-refine/scripts/: Executable that creates docs/ideas/; QuantSmith routes all Specify output into specs/NNNN-slug/spec.md, and vendored content is never executed (NFR-003).
excluded..claude/commands/build.md: Commits after every task and may generate its own plan; QuantSmith commits only when asked and takes tasks from tasks.md.
excluded..claude/commands/ship.md: Fans out to a go/no-go outside QuantSmith's release gates (deployment_release, deployment-check).
excluded.hooks/: Session-start hook injects the excluded meta-router and needs jq; the other hooks execute shell from vendored content (NFR-003).
